name: agyloop
description: Multi-Subagent Development Lifecycle Orchestrator for Google Antigravity

agyloop.name: agyloop
agyloop.description: Multi-subagent development lifecycle orchestrator (Context -> Plan -> Implement -> Gate -> Review -> Commit)

plan.description: Run read-only planning subagent and generate persistent specs in artifacts/plans/

implement.description: Resume straight from an approved plan with a fresh context

gates.description: Run quality and AI review gates on current working diff

yolo.description: Fast-path mode auto-approving plan gates while enforcing quality checks

--commit-after.description: Automatically commit if all quality gates and reviews pass green

planner.name: planner
planner.description: Architectural reasoning and deep read-only inspection subagent

implementer.name: implementer
implementer.description: Focused code generation and refactoring subagent loaded strictly from approved plan

gate.name: gate
gate.description: Fast, isolated quality gate subagent executing builds, tests, and linters

reviewer.name: reviewer
reviewer.description: Standards compliance and acceptance criteria review subagent
